cve_summary: Document Liberation Project libstaroffice before 2017-04-07 has an out-of-bounds write caused by a stack-based buffer overflow related to the DatabaseName::read function in lib/StarWriterStruct.cxx.
docstring:
"""
Summary: 
Reads a database name and associated data from a given StarZone.

Parameters: 
zone (StarZone &): The zone from which to read the database name and data.

Returns: 
bool: Returns true if the read operation is successful, false otherwise.

Logic: 
The function first checks if the input stream can read a database name. If not, it logs an error and returns false. It attempts to read a string representing the database name and table name, storing them in member variables. Depending on compatibility checks with the zone, it may also read additional SQL strings and data entries. If any read operation fails, it logs the error and returns true to indicate partial success. Finally, it logs the current state and closes the record before returning the success status.
"""
